The operating systemfor independenthotels.

A technology-enabled hotel management platform that runs the work every property repeats, centrally, so owners can focus on revenue, costs and performance.

See How CoastalOS Works Talk to Our Team

The opportunity

Your hotel shouldn’t require an entire company to operate it.

Every independent property carries the same jobs: reservations, front desk, pricing, guest messages, marketing, payroll, bookkeeping and reporting. Usually each one is handled separately, property by property.

Modern technology makes it possible to run much of that work once, centrally, and well. That leaves your on-site team free for the hospitality only they can deliver.

Each function runs on its own tools and people, and the owner is left connecting the pieces.

The CoastalOS platform

The work behind every stay, run in one place.

CoastalOS takes on the work behind a hotel that can be run centrally, from pricing and reservations to payroll and owner reporting. Your property keeps its brand and its on-site team.

  • Marketing & DistributionSearch, social, email and channel management that brings guests back direct.

item.title: About CoastalOS
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About CoastalOS

Built by hotel owners, for hotel owners.

CoastalOS comes from Coastal Hospitality Group, which has acquired, developed and operated independent hotels since 2012. The people behind the platform have done the work it now takes on for owners.

Three ways to run an independent hotel

  • Software vendorGives you tools.Useful technology, but you and your team still run reservations, pricing, staffing and reporting yourselves.
  • Traditional management companyRuns the hotel its own way.The day-to-day is handled for you, on the management company’s own terms and approach.
  • CoastalOSAn operator-built platform.Runs the core functions of your hotel centrally, while your brand, your guests and your independence stay yours.

Our origin

Developed inside real hotels, not a software lab.

CoastalOS is built by the team behind Coastal Hospitality Group. Founder and CEO Jed Tarr started the company in 2012 with a small beach motel in San Clemente, California. As of 2026, Coastal Hospitality Group has owned and operated 14 hotels, today in North Carolina, Florida and California.

Running those properties every day shaped how the platform works: the work that repeats at every property is run centrally, and the hospitality itself stays with the people on site. Coastal Management Company, the group’s operating company, reports that it often lifts a hotel’s bottom line by 10 to 30 percent within its first year of operating it. See how the platform works.

Who we work with

Owners and operators who want the systems of a larger operation while keeping their independence, their brand and their guests.

  • Independent hotels
  • Boutique hotels
  • Motels
  • Inns
  • Resorts

The platform

One operating platform. Every critical function.

How the work gets delivered: which functions our central team runs, which stay with your people on site, and what you see as the owner.

Request a Property Review Talk to Our Team

The operating model

Run once. Delivered to every property.

Every hotel repeats the same work: setting rates, answering booking questions, running payroll, closing the books, reporting to the owner. When each property does all of it alone, the effort and the cost are repeated too.

CoastalOS handles that shared work once, centrally, with one team and one set of tools, and delivers it to each property. Your on-site team keeps the parts of the job that only they can do.

  • Centralize what can be centralized.Pricing, reservations and the books are run by one experienced team for every property, rather than rebuilt at each hotel.
  • Automate what can be automated.Confirmations, reminders and routine reports go out on their own, so nobody has to remember to send them.
  • Keep hospitality human.When a guest needs something in person, the people at your property have the time to give it.

The guest journey

How a stay moves through the platform.

Each step shows who looks after it: the central team, your team on site, or both working together.

Five service groups, one operating platform.

These are the services CoastalOS delivers to each property. Each group lists what the central team handles, so you can see exactly what comes off your team’s plate.

  • Property Operations

Five service groups

  1. 01Revenue & DistributionGrow revenue
  2. 02Reservations & Guest SupportModernize the guest experience
  3. 03Property OperationsReduce operating costs
  4. 04Technology & AutomationReduce operating costs
  5. 05Financial & Owner ReportingGive owners visibility
01Grow revenue

Revenue & Distribution

Pricing, marketing and channels managed together, with a steady focus on bookings that come to you direct.

  • Revenue managementData-driven pricing and inventory decisions across every channel your property sells on.
  • Marketing & distributionSearch, social, email and channel management that keeps your property visible and brings guests back.
  • Direct bookingReservations through your own branded website, so more guests book with you directly.
02Modernize the guest experience

Reservations & Guest Support

A central team that looks after guests before, during and after their stay.

  • Central reservationsCalls, emails and booking requests handled centrally, in line with your property’s policies.
  • Guest communicationClear, timely messages before arrival and during the stay, so guests know what to expect.
  • Guest supportResponsive help when guests need it, with your on-site team kept informed.
03Reduce operating costs

Property Operations

Your on-site team stays focused on guests, with the structure behind them handled centrally.

  • On-site team managementSupport and oversight for the people who run your property day to day.
  • Hiring, scheduling & trainingHelp finding the right people, planning schedules and bringing new team members up to speed.
  • Operational controlsConsistent standards and checks that keep the property running the way it should.
04Reduce operating costs

Technology & Automation

Modern hotel technology set up and run for you, so routine work happens in the background.

  • Property management technologyThe core systems a hotel runs on, set up and managed as part of the platform.
  • Digital & self check-inConvenient, contactless arrival for guests who want it, with help available when they need it.
05Give owners visibility

Financial & Owner Reporting

Clear numbers and back-office support, so owners always know how the property is performing.

  • Payroll & HRPayroll and HR administration coordinated centrally, so it is handled consistently.
  • Financial reportingAccounting and financial statements that give a clear picture of the property.
  • Owner reportingReporting on revenue, occupancy, rates, expenses and labor, all in one place.

Questions owners ask

Before you get in touch.

Is CoastalOS software I install?

No. CoastalOS is an operating platform: our team, technology and processes working together to run the core functions of your hotel, centrally.

What size of property is it built for?

Independent and boutique hotels, motels, inns and resorts that want to keep their own brand and guests.

Do we keep our own brand?

Yes. Your property keeps its name, website and guests. CoastalOS works behind the scenes to grow direct business under your brand.

What happens in a property review?

We look at how your hotel runs today and where centralization and technology could add revenue, lower cost, or improve visibility.

How long does onboarding take? Sample

Most properties are fully on the platform within 30 to 60 days of signing, depending on the systems in place and the services chosen.

Does CoastalOS work with our existing systems? Sample

We review your property management system, channel manager and accounting tools during the property review, keep what works and plan any changes with you.

What does an agreement look like? Sample

Scope, fees and term are set out in a written agreement after the property review, so you know exactly what is covered before anything starts.

Can we choose individual services? Sample

Yes. Some owners start with selected service groups, such as revenue management or owner reporting, and add more over time.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 3, 2026

Who we are

This website is operated by CoastalOS, built by the team behind Coastal Hospitality Group, 711 S El Camino Real, San Clemente, CA 92672. In this policy, “we”, “us” and “our” refer to CoastalOS.

Information we collect

When you request a property review or a call, we collect the details you choose to give us:

  • Your name and work email address
  • Your property’s name, location and number of rooms
  • Whether you would like a review or a call, and any message you add

Like most websites, our hosting provider may also record basic technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you view. We do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels.

How we use your information

  • To respond to your request and arrange a property review or call
  • To prepare and discuss the review with you
  • To keep the website secure and working properly

We do not sell or rent your personal information, and we do not use it for unrelated marketing.

Who we share it with

We share information only with service providers that help us run this website and handle requests, such as our website host and email or form-processing services. They may use it only to provide those services to us. We may also disclose information where the law requires it.

Third-party services

This website loads fonts from Google Fonts, which means your browser connects to Google’s servers. Links to property websites open sites that have their own privacy policies.

How long we keep it

We keep inquiry details for as long as needed to respond and follow up on your request, and then delete them unless we need to keep them for legal or business-record reasons.

Your choices and rights

You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you have given us. If you are a California resident, you have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act, including the right to know what we collect and to request deletion. We will not discriminate against you for using these rights.

To make a request, email info@coastalhospitalitygroup.com.

Security

We use reasonable measures to protect the information you send us. No method of sending data over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Children

This website is intended for hotel owners and operators. It is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

Contact

Questions about this policy: info@coastalhospitalitygroup.com or (877) 350-0053.
